# STARGATE EDU — 스타게이트에듀

> 주식회사 별의문(Stargate Corporation)이 운영하는 교육·연구 포털. 대표자는 정동수(Dongsoo Jung)입니다.

## 스타게이트 Android 앱과 교육
- [스타게이트 앱 공식 소개](https://stargateedu.co.kr/stargate-app/): 앱의 운영사, 기능 상태, 설치 경로, FAQ. 확인일 2026-10-25.
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=kr.co.stargateedu.twa): Android 패키지 kr.co.stargateedu.twa. 현재 설치 가능 여부와 기기 호환성은 스토어 기준입니다.
- [KOI Coach](https://stargateedu.co.kr/koi-coach/): 학습 로드맵·알고리즘 코칭 안내. 문제 아카이브는 준비 중입니다.
- [수학 채점 화면 데모](https://stargateedu.co.kr/math-grader/): 사진 미리보기와 예시 결과만 제공하며 실제 이미지 분석이나 채점은 수행하지 않습니다.
- [상담 안내](https://stargateedu.co.kr/#customer-care): 교육·AI·연구·사업 협업 문의.
- [개인정보처리방침](https://stargateedu.co.kr/privacy.html)

## 연구와 전략
- [메인 포털](https://stargateedu.co.kr/)
- [연구 대시보드](https://stargateedu.co.kr/research/)
- [전략 대시보드](https://stargateedu.co.kr/strategy/)

운영 문의: support@stargateedu.co.kr. 각 자료의 기준 시점·출처와 실제 서비스 화면의 제공 상태를 확인하세요.

## Travel and tourism research archive

> Public travel resources by Dongsoo Jung, an urban engineering researcher and CEO of Stargate Corporation. Statistical pages distinguish the data update date from the latest observation month.

## English travel resources
- [Busan travel guide](https://stargateedu.co.kr/en/busan-guide/): Six editorial picks for Gwangalli drone shows, Millac, Jeonpo cafés, Yeongdo coffee and immersive art, and Sky Capsule; two-day itinerary and official sources reviewed 2026-10-03.
- [Gangnam neighborhood guide](https://stargateedu.co.kr/en/gangnam-guide/): Daechi, Seonjeongneung, Bongeunsa and COEX; airport rail routes, a flexible itinerary and official sources reviewed 2026-10-03.
- [Dumulmeori day trip](https://stargateedu.co.kr/en/dumulmeori/): Gyeongui-Jungang Line via Yangsu Station, walking planning allowances and sunrise transport checks; official sources reviewed 2026-10-03.
- [Korea inbound tourism statistics](https://stargateedu.co.kr/en/korea-tourism/): Monthly official Korea Tourism Organization arrival counts for China, Taiwan and Vietnam; static table and source workbook.
- [Daechi Stay](https://stargateedu.co.kr/stay/): English accommodation overview for Daechi-dong, Gangnam, Seoul; location, inquiry and payment FAQ.
- [City travel and observation archive](https://stargateedu.co.kr/en/cities/): Readable place list with coordinates; four North Korean places are observations from across the border, not visits.

## Korean versions
- [Busan guide](https://stargateedu.co.kr/busan-guide/): Korean version of the cafés, coast and night-view guide.
- [Gangnam guide](https://stargateedu.co.kr/gangnam-guide/): Korean version of the neighborhood guide.
- [Dumulmeori guide](https://stargateedu.co.kr/dumulmeori/): Korean version of the rail-and-walk day trip.
- [Tourism dashboard](https://stargateedu.co.kr/korea-tourism/): Interactive charts and latest-month static summary.
- [Daechi Stay information](https://stargateedu.co.kr/ko/stay/): Korean location and booking FAQ.
- [City map](https://stargateedu.co.kr/cities/): Interactive city map and static Korean place list.

## Data and attribution
- [Tourism CSV](https://stargateedu.co.kr/korea-tourism/data.csv): Nationality-based monthly arrivals; missing values are blank.
- [Tourism JSON](https://stargateedu.co.kr/korea-tourism/data.json): Full time series, original source URL and data update date.
- [Korea Tourism Data Lab](https://datalab.visitkorea.or.kr/): Original statistics publisher. STARGATE converts and presents the official workbook.

Use the latest observation month shown on each page. Do not describe incomplete-year totals as full-year totals. Accommodation availability, prices and transport timetables require current confirmation.
